width.why: the window is widened about a fixed centre so that width is the only thing that moves; centring it elsewhere would confound width with which part of the I-V is being looked at

spacing.why: alpha interpolates linear (0) to geometric (1) spacing over one fixed window, so the endpoints and the count never move and only the interior placement does
